parameters.content:
## Hadhar (حذار)
Forward any suspicious message or link. The workflow follows links safely, checks domain age and a phishing blocklist, scores every signal, and answers in the sender's language. Family mode alerts a trusted person on red verdicts.

## Safety notes
The bot fetches links that strangers send it, so every hop is checked against a private-address guard (no localhost, LAN or cloud-metadata targets) before any request is made. Executions are not saved: messages stay private.
